text: I think maybe my cat is too small for these toys. She was, unfortunately, afraid of most of them and disinterested in the others. I may try again after she’s grown more (she’s not quite an adult but not a kitten right now). I was also a little bummed about the toys because they didn’t seem worth what the price tags claimed. I bought a $1.50 cat toy from Kroger that was equal or better in quality to these toy and, comically, when I tossed the toys on the ground she ran and grabbed her Kroger toy after only sniffing these.  I’ll reintroduce this current box to her in about 5-6 months and see how she responds. If she likes them I’ll sign back up and change my review. Even if the prices seem off, they benefit cats in need so that worth something.
